QuestInfo.name: The Hidden Meaning Behind the Memory Fragments
QuestInfo.0: You have collected 12 Aran Memory Fragments. But they seem meaningless... What is the logic behind this? Cassandra probably knows the answer to the mystery.
QuestInfo.1: Hm? What? Huh? Each fragment has its place? Switch the order of the fragments around.
QuestInfo.2: July 9th, 2007. Will the Arans really revive?

0.0: Wow, I'm impressed. You've collected all 12 Aran Memory Fragments...What's that? You're curious what they signify?

yes.0: Look into the Aran Memory Fragments that have just been thrown into your bag. If you look closely, you'll find out what they mean. Come back to me when you've figured it out.
